title: When Ryusei Met Meteor...
overview: The reincarnated Hero visits the reincarnated Demon Lord, and the former NEET becomes a teacher at her school.

title: The Witches of Oz
overview: Meteor and Ryusei get to know the two new transfer students, and then their secret identities are revealed.

title: Midnight Run
overview: Meteor and Ryusei discuss the food of their old and new lives. Then they go on a dungeon date.

title: Those Who Can't Be Forgiven
overview: Ryusei fights off a Returner. Ryusei and Hanaori go through couples therapy.

title: Much Ado About Nothing
overview: Ryusei resolves some of the girls' troubles. Then he goes on a not-date with Meteor.

title: Pulp Fiction
overview: Hanaori gets turned into a cat. Then silenced. Then a magical girl from a parallel world attacks Ryusei.

title: Seven
overview: The witches gripe about their work for Oz. Hanaori gets corrupted and fights Ryusei.

title: Training Day
overview: Meteor finds out the holy sword Ryusei gave her is worth 1 billion yen. Ryusei trains the witches.

title: Scream
overview: Ryusei deals with a robot from another world and ghosts at the cultural festival. Ayame faces her bullies.
